prompts.label: Review an application
prompts.text:
Review this synthetic application against the criteria. Cite identifiers and distinguish missing evidence from noncompliance.

CRIT-1: Include a project budget.
CRIT-2: Identify a delivery timeline.
APP-1: Twelve weekly workshops starting October 1, led by a program lead and two facilitators. No budget is supplied.

prompts.label: Check a case record
prompts.text:
Review these synthetic case records for conflicting dates and missing evidence. Cite records without choosing an unsupported date.

CASE-1: Intake completed June 1, follow-up June 10.
CASE-2: Intake completed June 3, follow-up June 10.
CASE-3: Undated follow-up; a supporting document is outstanding.
